title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Alana Frederick serves as the career law clerk and chief of staff to Judge Kevin Newsom on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit. Alana also teaches and lectures regularly at various law schools, including Yale Law School, Stanford Law School, the University of Chicago Law School, and Harvard Law School. Her work […]
research_interests: Constitutional Law Jurisprudence and Legal Theory Law and Philosophy
